net_var = payslip.attendance_net_reconciled if payslip else 0.0 deficit_hours = abs(net_var) contract_obj = payslip.contract_id if (payslip and payslip.contract_id) else None employee_obj = payslip.employee_id if (payslip and payslip.employee_id) else None wage = contract_obj.wage if (contract_obj and contract_obj.wage) else (employee_obj.wage if (employee_obj and hasattr(employee_obj, 'wage') and employee_obj.wage) else 0.0) hourly_rate = wage / 240.0 result = -(deficit_hours * hourly_rate)
